text.formatted: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.
text.plain: The vulture has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

text.formatted: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.
text.plain: The vulture has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't Incapacitated.

text.formatted: The vulture makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.
text.plain: The vulture makes two attacks: one with its beak and one with its talons.
